table.retrieve:
SELECT   
	purledger.purinvcode,   
	purledger.purcatcode,
	purledger.purtypecode,
	purledger.printbalance,
	purledger.suppinvdate,
	purledger.grn,
	aliasname=accounts.aliasname,
	purledger.suppcode,   
	purledger.suppinvcode,
	purledger.pocode,   
	purledger.salesmancode,   
	purledger.date,   
	purledger.discperc,   
	purledger.flatdisc,   
	purledger.misccharges,   
	purledger.salestax,
    purledger.advancetaxamt,
	purledger.posted,   
	purledger.postdate,   
	purledger.remarks, 
	purledger.invtotal,  
	users.username,   
	supplier.address1,   
	supplier.city,   
	supplier.phone,   
	podate=Getdate(),   
	posupplierreference=SPACE(100),   
	manfname='                                        '  ,   
	manfcode=0,
	purledger.originaldate,
	purledger.modifiedby,
	purledger.postedby,
	purledger.porb,
	purledger.headerno,
	gcode=0,
	suppbalance=0.00,
	creditordebit=' ',
	dbo.purledger.purinvpagesize,
	purledger.invgstperc1,
	dbo.purledger.headerinvno,
	dbo.purledger.AccountFor,
	dbo.purledger.PaymentMode,
	dbo.purledger.PaymentAccCode,
	dbo.purledger.Amt,
	dbo.purledger.AmtBy,
	dbo.purledger.AmtDate,
	dbo.purledger.AmtReference,
	dbo.purledger.Outstandingamt,
	dbo.purledger.marked,
	dbo.purledger.currencycode,
	dbo.purledger.conversionfactor,
	dbo.purledger.AssociatedSaleOrderCode,
	dbo.purledger.AssociatedSaleInvCode,
	dbo.purledger.GCCode,
	dbo.purledger.Vehicle,
	dbo.purledger.ShipTo
FROM 
	purledger,   
	users,   
	supplier,
	accounts  
WHERE
	( purledger.suppcode = supplier.suppcode ) and  
	( purledger.suppcode = accounts.acccode )  and
	( purledger.salesmancode = users.usercode) and  
	( ( dbo.purledger.purinvcode = :r_InvCode ) )
